name: Boukenshatachi Kenja no Yuigon
original_name: 冒険者達 賢者の遺言
source:
Chinese style gag-comedy. You train in the mountains with your master. One day a mysterious stranger hands over a golden a key. And so the adventure starts...

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一部中式风格的恶搞喜剧。你随师父在山中修行。一天，一名神秘人交给你一把金钥匙，冒险就此开始……
